judgmentDemonstration.why: Identical code, deployed with all three bonds set to zero. The genlayer CLI has no flag for attaching GEN to a call, so the payable entry points cannot be exercised from it at all. A zero-bond instance runs the same judgments and the same settlement code with nothing at stake, which is what makes the verdicts below reachable without a browser wallet.
judgmentDemonstration.provesVerdictsNotSlashes: An adverse verdict and the slash it implies are different milestones. These runs prove the verdicts. No GEN has moved through a bond yet.

notProvenLive: Real fund movement above zero. claim() is the only path that moves GEN out, via gl.chain.Account(...).emit_transfer. The CLI cannot attach value to a payable call, so posting a real nonzero bond needs a browser wallet or a raw signing key. Every other write method -- create_root, propose_child, revise_child, revoke, request_review, challenge, prove_use, clear_taint -- has now been exercised live on chain (see liveVerification above), on a zero-bond twin deployment so the judgment and settlement code runs for real with nothing at stake.
